owner: CC owns the code and the proofs. Akien owns the bound already given and not CC's to widen: orient, then constrain, then survey, and the other four wait on these three WORKING (ruling 2026-08-14-the-preamble-compiles-to-learn-not-to-be-cheap).

watchme.trigger: each read of the probe over ~/.cairn/devices/chart/0/packets — no clock and no new firing path; it rides the shim's existing pulse and the read-side overdue() door, the same seam every other probe in the corpus sits on. TRUE when at least 12 packets have berthed UNDER THE NEW DOOR (filename stamp >= 20260814T000000) AND their median non-charter constraint count has fallen BELOW the minimum of the closed pre-build corpus, which is 2 — no packet the ceiling ever wrote carried fewer than two constraints of its own. The threshold is recomputed from that corpus on every read rather than frozen as a literal, so it is the corpus's number and not a constant someone chose (a hand-set gate is a learned value stranded in a human's head).
watchme.enough: CLEARED when at least 12 post-door packets have berthed AND their median non-charter count is holding at or above that pre-build floor — the claim this build has to survive. Deliberately NOT cleared on 'the floor earned its label': a rising floor fraction is what crowding-out LOOKS like, so clearing on it would retire the watch at exactly the moment it should bite. Measured rather than asserted — a starved fixture and a healthy fixture both read earned_floor 14 of 14, so the label cannot distinguish them and this clause must not rest on it.
watchme.carrier: cairn/devices/builder/machines/constrain/probes/crowding_out.py — module-level PROBE carrying both populations in ONE report (pre-build n, median, min; post-build n, median, min; the charter total; the per-field floor tally; and the starved berths by name), because a failure report delivers everything needed to resolve it on the first pass.
watchme.nexus: hypothesize — the finding is 'the ceiling stopped writing its own constraints', which is a hypothesis about why and not a fact about what: the floor's bulk is one cause and a ceiling gone quiet for unrelated reasons is another, and the report carries the charter-per-berth ratio that tells them apart.
watchme.consumer: harbor_master. It deposits and pokes and carries no authority: the back-edge that re-opens this ticket is the owner's act (Law 6). A fire means read skills/chart/SKILL.md stage 2 first — the ceiling is instructed to carry the floor's constraints through and ADD the kinds that need judgement, and a thin packet usually means that instruction now reads as 'the list is already full'.

intent_berth: none, because the intention is not mine and did not need the cheapest gate to survive: it is Akien's ruled build order of 2026-08-14 (ruling 2026-08-14-the-preamble-compiles-to-learn-not-to-be-cheap, 'starting with orientation, we build out everything we can now ... constrain will add to that'), whose sibling rung orient is CairnCommons/tickets/orient-floor-authors-and-provenance-is-measured.json. /intent exists to kill an intention that should not exist before cost is spent on it; an intention handed down by the owner with its sequencing already fixed has had that question answered by the hand that outranks the gate. RECORDED RATHER THAN FIRED, which is the legal answer the entry gate itself names — and it is the honest one only because the referents above resolve. Contrast the chart lack below, which has NO honest post-hoc answer and is therefore not exempted.
chart_claim: validate-20260828T052319-67401a3d141c — chart chain filled 2026-08-28 with real content; verdict berthed at verdict-20260828T052351-1ecf29b8eaf0
dependencies: MEASURED, not assumed: floor_facts already computes the component roster and path existence, and the constraint_traces judge already resolves a constraint's source through the berth gate's own ref semantics. Both applied unchanged.

orient-floor-authors-and-provenance-is-measured is the parent pattern and had to land first — constrain's floor reads the orient packet, so a floor that authors here needs refs that are grounded there. It PROVED the same morning.
NOT a dependency: hex.local. This build is what gives Hex something to fail over FROM, and it needs nothing from the box.
NOT a dependency and checked before building: no change to skills/chart/dial.py, whose code is faithful — what changes is that the labels it reads become derived.
filed_edges: THE DIAL NOW READS TWO DIFFERENT RULES AS ONE NUMBER. orient's _survived is set equality and constrain's is two-sided survival, both spelled 'floor'. Nothing announces the difference, and a reader comparing the two nexi is comparing two measurements. Either the dial grows a way to say which rule produced a reading, or the difference is footnoted where a reader will actually meet it. Not built here — it is the dial's own component and this ticket does not touch it.

THE THIRD OUTCOME orient's ticket already filed has its first real instance here: the ceiling EXTENDS the floor's answer (adds a ticket-kind or law-kind constraint beside the floor's charter ones) and that correctly reads 'floor' under the two-sided rule — but the ceiling adding a legitimate CHARTER-kind constraint the floor could not reach reads 'claude' and loses the fact that the floor's part survived. Measurable once post-door packets exist; not invented before then.

206 of the 246 non-charter live constraints are kinds the floor structurally cannot produce, and a further 20 one-off kinds appear exactly once or twice each (decision, proof, code-precedent, store-charter, prior-art, trouble...). That long tail is either a vocabulary that wants settling or evidence that constraint kinds are correctly open. Not a defect and not resolved — recorded so the question is asked from data when it is asked.

The floor reaches a component's charter and stops there. A constraint could equally be read from a ticket's own falsifier or from a law, both of which are lookups over files on disk. Deliberately out of this build (build minimal, grow against need), and it is the obvious next place the floor could compile into — but only against evidence that the ceiling is spending its judgement transcribing them.
